book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: قعدوا على طاولة، وفيكس طلب شراب.
sentences.en: They sat at a table, and Fix ordered drink.
And drank a glass, and two.

sentences.ar: وقال فيكس: يا صاحبي، لازم أحكي لك الحقيقة.
sentences.en: And Fix said: my friend, I must tell you the truth.
Passepartout said: I know it!
You are a spy from the club!
Watching my master!
And laughed.
And Fix looked at him, and was silent.
And then said: no.

sentences.ar: وطلع من جيبه ورقة، وحطها عالطاولة.
sentences.en: And took from his pocket a paper, and put it on the table.
A police card.
He said: I am a detective.
From Scotland Yard.
And your master is a thief.
He robbed the Bank of England.
Fifty-five thousand pounds.
Passepartout stood up.
And said: a lie!
Fix said: and the wager is an excuse.
And the money he hands out is from the bank.
Help me keep him here.
For one night.
And you get your share of the reward.
Passepartout sat, his face red.

sentences.ar: وقال: إنت... إنت بدك أخون سيدي؟
sentences.en: And said: you... you want me to betray my master?
Who saved Aouda?
Who paid two thousand for me?
No!
And Fix said: fine.
You will not help me.
But keep quiet.
And poured him a third glass.
And a fourth.
And Passepartout drank, because he was upset.
And then, Fix handed him a pipe.
An opium pipe.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو، اللي ما كان يعرف، أخد نفس.
sentences.en: And Passepartout, who did not know, took a draw.
And two.
And his head grew heavy, and the world spun.
And he fell onto the table.

sentences.ar: وفيكس دفع الحساب، وقال: بيصحى بكرا الظهر.
sentences.en: And Fix paid the bill, and said: he wakes tomorrow at noon.
And his master waits for him, and the steamer leaves.

sentences.ar: وطلع، وهو ما بيعرف إنه غلط.
sentences.en: And went out, not knowing he had made a mistake.

sentences.ar: لأنه القبطان غير الموعد، والكارناتيك بتطلع الليلة، مش بكرا.
sentences.en: Because the captain had changed the time, and the Carnatic sailed tonight, not tomorrow.
